records.text: On the night of the shooting, White House campus security and staffing were unusually ready: personnel were available and on standby, and events ran too smoothly for an unplanned response.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #2 (Ep Pb7UlpRdW6U)

appearances.snippet: Internal teams tell me that what is most remarkable is that for some reason, that email, that evening, the White House campus security protocol and the perimeters were just out of the ordinary. Everybody was somehow available and on standby for some unknown reason. ... They said things ran too smoothly. They've been in situations where it is a situation and people scramble. That was not what occurred that night.

verification.notes: Public reporting documents a rapid law-enforcement response, but no staffing logs, security rosters, internal records, or comparative baseline show that White House campus personnel were unusually available or on standby before the attack.

conveyance.original_source: Information supplied by White House sources
